message.content:
Explore /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/CROBOT and report on three things I need to know before planning a Playwright-driven QA pass.

Report in under 300 words. No recommendations — just what exists.

## 1. Testing infrastructure currently in place
- Is Playwright installed? Check package.json for `@playwright/test` or `playwright`
- Any existing `playwright.config.ts`, `e2e/`, `tests/`, `__tests__/`, `*.spec.ts`, `*.test.ts`?
- Any other test runners (vitest, jest, cypress)?
- Any CI workflow files (.github/workflows/*.yml) that run tests?

## 2. App routes to test
Walk `app/` and produce the full list of route paths. Group into:
- Public (no auth needed): list each with its page.tsx path
- Authed user routes (under `app/(app)/`): list each
- Admin routes (under `app/(app)/admin/`): list each
- Dynamic routes with params: note which params are required
- API routes under `app/api/`: list each

## 3. What would block automated testing
- Is there a test user or seed data? Check for any `seed`, `fixtures`, `test-user` references
- Is the dev server launched with `pnpm dev` on port 3000?
- Supabase config — is auth gated by email confirmation? (check supabase/config.toml and any auth setup)
- Any env vars the app absolutely needs that aren't in `.env.example`?
- Is the Railway deployment live at `https://crobot.up.railway.app`? (just report the URL, don't fetch)

Do NOT modify any files — read-only.

# ConvertScan (CROBOT)

AI-powered CRO (Conversion Rate Optimization) audit tool. Users paste a URL and get instant, scored analysis with specific AI-generated suggestions to boost conversions.

## Stack
- **Framework**: Next.js 16 (App Router) + React 19 + TypeScript strict
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS v4 + shadcn/ui (Radix primitives)
- **Backend**: Supabase **cloud** (Auth + Postgres + Edge Functions + Storage) — project ref `ovlreynsgoccjzvczglp`
- **AI**: Claude API (claude-sonnet-4-20250514) for Vision + Text analysis
- **Billing**: Dodo Payments (subscriptions)
- **Email**: Resend
- **Performance**: Google PageSpeed Insights API
- **Screenshots**: Puppeteer service on Railway
- **Monitoring**: Sentry (@sentry/nextjs)
- **Package manager**: pnpm 9.15.4 (Node 20+)

## Architecture
- Next.js 16 App Router with RSC + Server Actions + route handlers under `app/api/`
- Supabase SSR via `@supabase/ssr` — browser client in [lib/supabase/client.ts](lib/supabase/client.ts), server client in [lib/supabase/server.ts](lib/supabase/server.ts)
- Session refresh + route protection in root-level [middleware.ts](middleware.ts)
- Edge Functions (Deno runtime) in `supabase/functions/` deployed to cloud
- Database: Postgres via Supabase cloud with RLS on every table
- No local Supabase stack — all work runs against the cloud project

## Pricing Tiers (4-tier model)
- **Free**: 3 scans/month, basic score, top 3 suggestions
- **Starter** ($29/mo): 5 scans, all suggestions, basic PDF
- **Growth** ($49/mo): 25 scans, AI rewrites, PDF, monitoring, benchmarks
- **Pro** ($99/mo): Unlimited scans, everything in Growth + team workspaces (3 seats), API, integrations
- **Agency** ($199/mo): Unlimited scans, white-label, 10 seats, client portal, bulk processing, API

## The 7 CRO Pillars
1. Value Proposition (18% weight)
2. CTA Effectiveness (20% weight)
3. Trust Signals (17% weight)
4. Visual Hierarchy (12% weight)
5. Mobile Experience (13% weight)
6. Content & Copy (11% weight)
7. Page Performance (9% weight)

## Directory Layout
```
app/                     Next.js App Router
  (app)/                 authenticated app route group (dashboard, scan, reports, …)
  (auth)/                public auth route group (login, signup, reset)
  api/                   route handlers
  r/                     public shareable reports
  changelog/ pricing/ privacy/ terms/
components/
  admin/ api/ app/ audit/ auth/ competitors/ dashboard/ integrations/
  onboarding/ providers/ scan/ shared/ team/ ui/
hooks/                   custom React hooks (use-*.ts)
lib/
  supabase/              client.ts, server.ts, middleware.ts, types.ts
  pdf-generator.ts score-utils.ts constants.ts query-client.ts utils.ts
types/                   database.ts, index.ts
contexts/                React context providers
middleware.ts            Next.js middleware (session refresh + route protection)
supabase/
  config.toml            cloud-linked (project_id = ovlreynsgoccjzvczglp)
  migrations/            14 SQL files, source of truth for schema
  functions/             17 edge functions, deployed to cloud
```

## Key Files
- [app/layout.tsx](app/layout.tsx) — root layout, providers, theme
- [middleware.ts](middleware.ts) — session refresh + protected route enforcement
- [lib/supabase/client.ts](lib/supabase/client.ts) — browser Supabase client
- [lib/supabase/server.ts](lib/supabase/server.ts) — server client + `getAuthenticatedUser()` + `createServiceRoleClient()`
- [lib/constants.ts](lib/constants.ts) — CRO pillars, weights, plan limits, pricing tiers
- [lib/score-utils.ts](lib/score-utils.ts) — scoring algorithm, color mapping
- [lib/pdf-generator.ts](lib/pdf-generator.ts) — client-side PDF generation
- [types/database.ts](types/database.ts) — Supabase schema types
- [supabase/functions/analyze-url/](supabase/functions/analyze-url/) — main scan orchestrator
- [supabase/functions/pagespeed/](supabase/functions/pagespeed/) — Google PageSpeed integration
- [supabase/functions/dodo-checkout/](supabase/functions/dodo-checkout/), `dodo-portal`, `dodo-webhook` — Dodo Payments
- [supabase/functions/send-email/](supabase/functions/send-email/) — Resend email service

## Database Tables
- `profiles` — user profiles with plan/billing info
- `scans` — audit scan records
- `scan_results` — per-pillar results with findings JSONB
- `integrations` — third-party service connections
- `audit_logs` — admin action tracking
- `support_tickets` — support system
- `feature_flags` — feature toggle system
- `system_config` — key/value runtime config (plan limits, pillar weights)
- Plus: teams + team_members (011), api_keys (012), copy_rewrites (008), score_history (009), competitor_comparison (010), growth features (013), monitoring (014)

## Commands
- `pnpm dev` — Next.js dev server on port 3000
- `pnpm build` — production build
- `pnpm start` — production server
- `pnpm typecheck` — `tsc --noEmit`
- `pnpm lint` — `eslint app components hooks lib --max-warnings=0`
- `supabase db push` — apply migrations to cloud
- `supabase functions deploy <name>` — deploy a single edge function
- `supabase secrets set KEY=value` — set edge function secrets (cloud)
